ModMetaData.name: Builders Don't Cut Plants
ModMetaData.author: silvanalig95-cmd
ModMetaData.description:
Builders no longer cut down trees and other plants that are in the way of construction. The plant gets a normal "cut" order instead, so it is cut by the pawns you assigned to plant cutting (with their skill, speed and harvest yield) while your builders keep building.
Works for blueprints, frames, reinstalls and building roofs.
- Plants are marked for cutting as soon as you place a blueprint or a roof area (can be turned off). - If you cancel a blueprint, the cut orders this mod placed for it are removed again. - Special plants (anima tree, Gauranlen tree, ...) are never marked automatically. You get a message instead. - Right-click a blocked blueprint with a builder to see what it is waiting for.
Settings: - Only trees: builders still clear bushes, crops and other plants themselves. - Include roofs: also for trees that block roof building. - If nobody on the map is assigned to plant cutting, builders cut themselves so construction can't get stuck (on by default). - Builders with a high Plants skill may cut themselves (off by default).
Compatibility: - Only Harmony postfixes, no new defs, nothing is saved in your save game. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. - Multiplayer-friendly: nothing is changed from the right-click menu, only from the normal game simulation. - Uses the vanilla cut order, so anything that works with plant cutting works with this.
